profile_text.body:
# Technology Innovation Institute

The Technology Innovation Institute is a government-owned scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council. Founded in 2020, TII describes itself as advancing AI innovation with a focus on making "advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere."

TII's primary AI offering is the Falcon large language model family, an open-source project available under Apache 2.0 license. The company's site describes Falcon models across multiple scales and capabilities: Falcon 180B, a 180-billion-parameter model trained on 3.5 trillion tokens; Falcon 40B, trained on one trillion tokens; and Falcon 2 11B, described as outperforming Meta's LLaMA 3 8B and performing on par with Google Gemma 7B according to Hugging Face Leaderboard verification. Additional variants include Falcon-H1, combining Transformer and Mamba architectures; Falcon Mamba 7B, described as the first open-source State Space Language Model; Falcon H1R 7B, focused on reasoning; Falcon Arabic, built for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects; and Falcon Perception, a multimodal model combining vision and language capabilities. TII has also established the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to advancing open-source generative AI development and building sustainable ecosystems around open-source projects.
